name: Themewant Product Gallery
author: themewant

sections.description:
All-in-One WooCommerce Product Gallery Plugin to Display Images & Videos Beautifully, Improve Shopping Experience, and Increase Sales Effortlessly. Want to improve your product page design and increase sales? Do you have multiple images to showcase your product? No problem! WooCommerce Product Gallery helps you turn the default WooCommerce product gallery into a beautiful and interactive image slider. Display your product and variation images in a clean, modern gallery layout that grabs customer attention and creates a better shopping experience..

Live Demo | Docs | Support

Why Use WooCommerce Product Gallery?:

  • Enable Additional Variation Images Gallery Slider
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly design.
  • Customizable gallery layout.
  • Easy navigation with image zoom and lightbox support.
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce themes.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • Add Engaging Product Video Galleries
  • Powerful Image Zoom for Better Product Detail View
  • Smooth Lightbox Popup for Product Images
  • Image 360 Degree view

WooCommerce Product Gallery simplifies the process of enhancing your product pages with an engaging image gallery. Highlight product details with an interactive experience to boost customer confidence and sales.

External Services

This plugin makes use of the following third-party open-source libraries to provide enhanced functionality. None of these libraries collect or transmit personal data outside your WordPress installation.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the themewant-product-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the WooCommerce product page to see the enhanced image gallery.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce Product Gallery compatible with my theme?

Yes, WooCommerce Product Gallery is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

What does WooCommerce Product Gallery do?

Product Gallery slider replaces the default WooCommerce product gallery with a modern, responsive image slider that supports images, videos, zoom, lightbox, and variation image galleries to create a better shopping experience.

Can I add multiple images for each product variation?

Yes. Product Gallery Slider allows you to add unlimited images for each product variation such as color, size, or style. When customers switch variations, the gallery automatically updates to show the relevant images.

Which video sources are supported in the product gallery?

The plugin supports multiple video sources including YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Facebook, and self-hosted videos. Videos can be displayed alongside product images within the gallery.

Can I choose where product videos appear in the gallery?

Yes. You can control the position of product videos in the gallery slider. Supported positions include Top, Left, Bottom, or Default placement.

Does the plugin support product image zoom?

Yes. Yes WooCommerce Image Gallery includes powerful zoom functionality that allows customers to inspect product details by hovering over images.

What Product zoom styles are available?

The plugin offers multiple zoom styles including: Standard Zoom, Zoom Window, Zoom Window Two, Zoom Inner. You can also customize the zoom lens appearance, overlay opacity, and zoom window settings.

Does the plugin include a lightbox feature?

Yes. The plugin includes a built-in lightbox popup that lets customers open product images in a larger view and navigate through them easily.

Can I customize the Product Slider lightbox design?

Yes. You can customize various lightbox options such as: Transition effects, Close icon color and background, Image captions, Image counter display, Icon positions

Can I customize the gallery layout?

Absolutely! The plugin offers multiple layout options that you can configure to match your store’s design.

Does it support Product image zoom and lightbox?

Yes, the gallery includes zoom and lightbox functionality for a seamless viewing experience.

Does the plugin support 360° product view?

Yes. You can display products in an interactive 360° image view popup, allowing customers to explore products from every angle.

Can I control the position of the 360° view button?

Yes. You can place the 360° popup button in different positions such as Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Left, or Bottom Right, and adjust the button offset as needed.

Can I customize the WooCommerce product gallery slider behavior?

Yes. The plugin provides several slider customization options including: Autoplay, Infinite loop,Slider speed, Slide direction (horizontal or vertical), Mouse wheel control.

Is the gallery responsive and mobile-friendly?

Yes. woocommerce product gallery carousel is fully responsive and works smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does the plugin support RTL (Right-to-Left) languages?

Yes. The plugin supports RTL languages, making it compatible with websites that use right-to-left text directions.

What image transition effects are available?

The Product gallery slider supports multiple transition effects including: Slide, Fade, Flip, Cube, Coverflow, Creative
